Name: Willy's Fishing Lesson Event (CP)
Author: VetoCV
Description:
There is a hidden vanilla cutscene where Willy visits your farmhouse, gifts you a training rod, and raises your fishing skill to level 1. The catch is that it only fires if you haven't gained a single fishing level yet by Spring 28 of Year 1, which almost never happens on a normal playthrough. This mod lets you adjust the day, fishing level threshold, weather requirement, intro event requirement, and which rod Willy gifts you.
Note: The event includes a small fishing experience gain. This has no meaningful effect if triggered at higher fishing levels and will not alter your current skill level.


[size=5][u][b]Config Options[/b][/u][/size]
[list]
[*]WillyVisitDay — How many days into the save before Willy can visit. Default is 27 (Spring 28, Year 1).[/*]
[*]FishingLevelThreshold — Willy only visits if the player hasn't reached this fishing level yet. Default is 1, matching vanilla. Raise it to allow the event to fire even after gaining a few levels.[/*]
[*]RequireSunnyWeather — Whether sunny weather is required for Willy to visit. Default is true, matching vanilla behavior. Set to false to allow the event to fire regardless of weather.[/*]
[*]RequireWillyIntroduction — Whether Willy's introduction event must have been seen before he visits. Default is true, matching vanilla behavior. Set to false to allow the event to fire even if you've never left your farm.[/*]
[*]FishingRodChoice — Which fishing rod Willy gifts you during the event. Default is TrainingRod, matching vanilla. Options: TrainingRod, BambooPole, FiberglassRod, IridiumRod, AdvancedIridiumRod.
[u]Note[/u]: Willy's dialogue will name the rod correctly, but the surrounding dialogue was written for the Training Rod and won't perfectly match other selections.
[u]Note[/u]: If you skip the event, you will always receive a Training Rod regardless of this setting. I'm currently looking into a fix for this, will update if I find a solution.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5][u]Event Conditions [/u][/size]
[/b]In addition to the config options above, the following vanilla conditions must also be met for the event to fire:
[list]
[*]The time must be between 6:00am and 11:30am[/*]
[*]By default, you must have seen event 739330 (Willy's introduction event where he gifts his old rod, triggered by visiting the beach early in the game). This requirement can be removed via the RequireWillyIntroduction config option as of version 1.2.0.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with mods that raise the fishing level cap beyond 10, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1471?tab=description]Level Extender[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054]Vanilla Plus Professions[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿﻿ (SVE)[/*]
[*]Incompatible with any mods that also edit this event (event ID 980559). I'm not aware of any conflicts currently, so let me know if you find one![/*]
[/list]
[u][b][size=5]Recommended Mods[/size][/b][/u]

[/list]
[b][size=4]Language Support[/size][/b]: This mod is currently English only. Feel free to upload your own translated version of this mod, no need to ask for permission!
